title: CARDIA Wins VIT Hackulus 2026
detail: Emerged as overall winners of VIT Hackulus 2026, a 24-hour national hackathon at VIT graVITas. The team developed CARDIA, an interactive 3D heart simulation combining real-time 3D visualization, interactive heart anatomy, simulated blood flow, and an AI-powered RAG layer.

title: SGC Members Shine at Yuva Future 6.0
people: Samiiksha, Zakwan Haaziq, Pooja Sri & Afra Naushine
detail: Samiiksha and Md. Zakwan Haaziq emerged as winners at the Vellore Regional Level in the Health vertical with SAHARA, a stigma-free student mental health support system. Pooja Sri and Afra Naushine were selected in the Road Safety vertical with Golden 60, a bystander-response system for the crucial post-accident Golden Hour. Both teams advanced to the National Level representing Vellore across Tamil Nadu.

title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 Winners
detail: Dhanush and his teammates emerged victorious at the prestigious Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025. Their innovative technological solution and outstanding teamwork earned them highest national recognition at India's premier government-backed innovation competition.

title: SGC Recruitment Drive 2026: 100+ Student Participation
detail: The March 2026 Recruitment Drive witnessed over 100 enthusiastic first-year engineering students participating in aptitude, interviews, and orientation sessions, continuing SGC's legacy of peer-to-peer mentorship and youth leadership.

title: Abubakkar Siddiq Secures 7.5 LPA Offer at TCS
detail: Dedicated core member Abubakkar Siddiq achieved a premier 7.5 LPA placement offer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), reflecting years of continuous technical rigor, peer leadership, and self-guided engineering at SGC.

title: 1st Prize at Mini Project Expo — PRINTMATE
detail: Awarded First Prize along with a ₹5,000 cash honor at the Mini Project Expo for PRINTMATE. The team created a smart automated printing and document workflow system that impressed technical evaluators with its elegance and utility.

title: GURO Python Package Presented at IBM Build2Learn
detail: Presented their newly engineered open-source Python library GURO before 50+ IT professionals, architects, and industry experts at the prestigious IBM Build2Learn summit in Chennai.

title: State-Level Speech Win Honoured by Deputy Chief Minister
detail: Selected for the State Level Speech Competition held during Muthamizh Arignar Kalaignar Centenary Fest by the Government of Tamil Nadu, and personally honoured by the Honorable Deputy Chief Minister Thiru. Udhayanidhi Stalin in Chennai.

title: MITACS Globalink Research Internship (Canada)
detail: Selected for the world-renowned MITACS Globalink Research Internship '24 in Canada, representing SGC and CAHCET on the international academic research stage for a three-month fully-funded advanced fellowship.
